stem:
Siddharth wants daily habits and surroundings that support a healthy body and a healthy mind. He reviews three weekend claims.

Which statements are correct?

statements.text: A balanced meal, outdoor play with friends, and sleep on time support good health.
Lying awake watching videos can replace the sleep needed for health.
Supportive friendships do not count as health-supporting because they affect feelings, not fitness.

teacher.key_rationale: Food, activity, sleep, and supportive relationships with clean safe surroundings support body and mind. Late videos do not replace sleep. Friendships that support feelings still support health.
